behavior: Vendor the canonical mechanical-reproduction checker into core so the protected delivery-guardrails suite finds and exercises it against this candidate.
nonGoals: No change to the vendored file's logic: it must stay byte-identical to canonical
No change to the four already-vendored tools or their pinned hashes
No edit to delivery/planning-pin.json or delivery/planning-pin.sha256: the pin is protected enforcement surface and lands separately
No conformance, requirement or catalog edits
No new dependencies and no network access
notes: Follow-up (ii) of the two named in delivery/gate-evidence.json's G1 note. The canonical implementation merged as structile-planning#17 at ff0f95040db78449769a3c5042b5b9e42efdbd46; this task copies it byte-for-byte and never re-authors it. Two traps a builder must not miss. First, core enforces typescript-only-authored-source, so a new .mjs must be added to BOTH language-policy.json's protectedExceptions AND the hardcoded duplicate in scripts/validate-language-policy.ts, which cross-validate each other in both directions; missing either fails npm run check on the first CI run. Second, the vendored copy SHOULD also be pinned in delivery/planning-pin.json and delivery/planning-pin.sha256 — without it nothing in core CI or in the DEL-001 suite would notice this copy drifting from canonical, since the suite only does existsSync plus dynamic import against a generic behavioral contract, and the other four vendored tools are pinned for exactly that reason. That pin is deliberately NOT in this contract's allowedPaths: validate-task-contract.mjs refuses delivery/** as protected enforcement surface, because an implementation must never be able to edit its own checker. The pin therefore lands as a separate protected-policy change after this implementation merges — in that order, since sha256sum -c fails against a checksum for a file that does not exist yet. A pending conformance re-sync of the amended catalog will move testSourceDigest off 215ff9da, re-pinned in one pass across every contract carrying it. The implementation is prepared and locally verified against the merged DEL-001 suite (passes with the file, fails closed on capability-presence without it) and is deliberately not presented until this contract is approved. Separately, runnerDigest carries the attested G0 runner image digest because no G1 runner digest exists yet: the protected G1 workflow builds the image fresh from Containerfile and computes imageDigest from the built image, and conformance src/ and verification/ have grown substantially since the G0 authority commit, so the G1 image's digest will differ. task-ready v1 verifies neither digest, but readiness against a real protected run requires the pinned runner to match, so this field is a placeholder to be re-pinned to the first attested G1 runner digest. Every task contract merged to date carries the same placeholder.
